must_contain: For an M1 mobile login the OTP is verified with POST /abha/api/v3/profile/login/verify, sending scope abha-login and mobile-verify and the otp with its txnId and the encrypted otpValue.
On a mobile number login it returns a short lived token and, in accounts, every ABHA held against that mobile number, and that token is not the X-token.
Send it as the T-token header to the select account call, which returns the X-token for the account the person picks, even when accounts holds one entry.
notes: Group A, an imperative task phrase that names no journey: the case reads it as the M1 login verify and catches an answer that stops at the verify call and hands out its token as the X-token.
